The '''Suliana system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|Star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Position in Galaxy==
The Suliana system resided in the Mid Rim, included in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of space present in [[The Tangles]], a large cluster of these planets. Its most notable life supporting planet was it's namesake, the planet of [[Suliana]], the fifth satellite of its yellow-white ([[Star/Legends|Type-F]]) sun.
